business_summary.text: Lumax Industries Limited is a leading manufacturer of automotive lighting components, supplying to major OEMs across passenger vehicles, 2-wheelers, and commercial vehicles in India.

call_points.text: FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 10.5-11%, up from 9.8% in FY26.
FY27 revenue growth guided at least 2x industry growth.
Mid-term goal of close to 13% EBITDA margin over 3-4 years.
FY27 capex guided at ₹100-150 Cr, including maintenance capex.
Bengaluru plant expansion expected to be commissioned from Q4FY27.
Input-cost inflation and one-quarter pass-through lag may pressure Q1 margins.
Long-term debt ₹235 Cr as of March 2026; ₹85-90 Cr repayment planned in FY27.
Interest cost seen at about ₹80 Cr in FY27, up from ₹74 Cr in FY26.
SL Lumax JV FY26 turnover about ₹2,900 Cr with EBITDA margin close to 14%.
LED lighting now 61% of revenue, up from 58% last year.
Order book stands at **₹2,200 Cr**, with **88%** comprising LED lighting products.
FY26 EBITDA margin improved by **130 bps** to **9.8%** driven by premiumization.
Management remains cautiously optimistic on the outlook for **FY27**.

timeline.summary: 27 Apr 2026: ICRA upgraded Lumax Industries' long-term rating to AA- (Stable) from A+ and short-term to A1+ from A1 across ₹1,502.93 Cr of rated bank facilities.

Lumax Industries Limited scheduled an earnings call on June 1, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST for Q4 & FY 2026 performance with **Deepak Jain**, **Anmol Jain**, **Sanjay Mehta**, **Raju Ketkale**, **Ravi Teltia**, **Naval Khanna**, and **Surabhi Chandna** participating.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,200.32 Cr (+30.0% YoY), net profit ₹54.1 Cr (+23.0% YoY).
On May 28, 2026, Lumax Industries released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, reporting record revenue of ₹4,184 Cr and EBITDA of ₹412 Cr.
Lumax Industries reported FY26 revenue of ₹4,184.2 Cr and PAT of ₹172.5 Cr, driven by higher LED lighting share.
5 Jun 2026: Lumax Industries filed the transcript of its 1 Jun 2026 Q4 & FY26 earnings call, guiding FY27 EBITDA margin to 10.5-11% and capex to ₹100-150 Cr.
Lumax Industries Limited held its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on August 11, 2026, reporting strong revenue growth and providing updated guidance.
Earnings call scheduled for Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 11:00 AM IST.
